subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Sometimes the wind is just wind.”?
options: It can begin when someone notices a small waste and says something.
Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.
If people want future readers to understand today's online world, someone must save it before links break and pages vanish.
It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It can begin when someone notices a small waste and says something.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Sometimes the wind is just wind. Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「If people want future readers to understand today's online world, someone must save it before links break and…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It also shows that someone has thought about the person using it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Sometimes the wind is just wind. Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.」，答案為「Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Looking for facts before blaming someone can save a lot of anger.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
